title: When the Monsoon Burns
author: Wren Oyelaran
blurb: Noor Iversen, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
